simulator.title: Simulate a successful payment
simulator.intro: Separate sandbox: fictional dossiers, no real payment or external delivery. A test payment opens the administrative actions to try.
simulator.accept: I confirm this fictional scenario and the displayed terms, without a charitable tax receipt.
simulator.confirmed: Simulated payment confirmed by the API. The journey is ready.
simulator.error: Simulation is not confirmed. Retry the same payment; an error never indicates success.
simulator.paying: Confirming the simulated payment and reading remaining actions…
simulator.openJourney: Open the journey and actions to test
simulator.supplierHint: To test logos and photos, play the sponsor in a new tab: continue to their profile and submit fictional files. Then return here to review them.
simulator.newPayment: Another scenario — keep the previous dossier

title: Controller across administration
intro: The controller follows you between pages. The gold outline identifies the selected control.
primary: Activate the control or open the on-screen editor
secondary: Cancel the panel or return to the content
safety: Release the button between actions. Sensitive operations keep their confirmation. Decision shortcuts remain available in the control desk.

virtual.title: Virtual Xbox controller
virtual.ready: Ready · mouse controls the selected item
virtual.hint: Click or hold a button. Drag the sticks and trigger bars. The gold outline stays on the selected item. Release between actions; confirmations remain required.
virtual.diagnostic: RT, L3, R3, Xbox and the right stick’s horizontal axis are visible for diagnostics; they have no page command. The physical controller is paused while this panel is open.

editor.title: Type with the controller
editor.invalid: This value does not match the field format or limits. Correct it before applying.
editor.unavailable: This field can no longer be edited. Close the editor and check the page.
editor.changed: This field changed while the editor was open. Close the editor and read its new value.

formats.number: A number; use a period for decimals
